idea: A tool/app that lets AI models create 3D models live: assists with blank/gap filling, raises design detail and realism beyond stitched-together cubes, handles angle adjustments and part clipping (e.g. railings), supports multi-agent/sub-agent task assignment, and is built to raise model accuracy, detail attention and spatial awareness. Blender/bpy acceptable as a base.
next: Phase 5 fix loop: 7 P0/P1 fixed and regression-tested. 10 confirmed findings open (Q-008..Q-017); Q-008 and Q-009 are the most consequential because ADR-005 gives measurement authority over the agent. Then re-run the gate, then Phase 6.
